title: secrets flow via docker compose secrets file mounts, no plaintext literal in compose.yaml
asA: shelf consumer applying the platform-docker-compose-host v1.0.0 blueprint on a project with secret material bound to a container
iWant: every secret to be declared under the compose secrets top-level key and mounted into the service via secrets: rather than inlined as an environment literal
soThat: the compose file is safe to read at review time and the mounted file inherits 0o400 inside the container

acceptanceCriteria.description: The applied compose.yaml declares at least one secret under the top-level secrets: key with a file: source and references it from the consuming service through the service-level secrets: array. The mounted secret file lands at mode 0o400 inside the container.

F-10 security-secrets-management integration: when the applied project has security-secrets-management applied (per the companion), a top-level secret's file: source resolves through the companion's vault-fetch script rather than a plain file path. A fixture with SIMULATE_SSM_APPLIED=true rewrites the source to a script call and asserts the mounted content still lands at 0o400 inside the container.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture with SIMULATE_SSM_APPLIED=true routing the secret file source through the companion
acceptanceCriteria.when: the mount is observed inside the container
acceptanceCriteria.then: the file at /run/secrets/<name> has content and mode 0o400

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-10 file-based fallback: when security-secrets-management is NOT applied, the fallback path lands the secret in secrets/<name> under the applying repo with a .gitignore line naming the file. A fixture assertion greps .gitignore for "secrets/<name>" and asserts the entry is present; SIMULATE_SECRETS_UNIGNORED=true removes the .gitignore line and the assertion FAILS naming the unignored file.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture without SSM applied, with a secret at secrets/<name>
acceptanceCriteria.then: the .gitignore contains a line matching "secrets/<name>"; SIMULATE_SECRETS_UNIGNORED=true trips the assertion

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-10 wrong mode: SIMULATE_WRONG_MODE_SECRET=true mounts the secret with mode: 0o644 in the service-level secrets: block (a compose-supported permissions override). The compose-config-lint probe FAILS naming the service and the wrong mode; the lint asserts every mounted secret carries mode 0o400 or the compose default (which resolves to 0o400).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture with SIMULATE_WRONG_MODE_SECRET=true setting mode: 0o644 on a service-mounted secret
acceptanceCriteria.then: the lint FAILS naming the service and the disallowed mode

acceptanceCriteria.description: Unreferenced top-level secret: a top-level secrets: block whose entry no service references is a defect (an orphan secret file that lands nowhere). The compose-config-lint FAILS naming the orphan secret; SIMULATE_ORPHAN_SECRET=true adds an entry no service consumes and the lint catches it.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture with SIMULATE_ORPHAN_SECRET=true adding an unreferenced top-level secret
acceptanceCriteria.then: the lint FAILS naming the orphan secret
